name: zvid_image_query_pixel_data_bytes
description: zVid_Image::QueryPixelDataBytes returns pixelCount for paletted images and bytes-per-pixel times pixelCount for unpacked image data.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x46ec40 validates the paletteMetaPacked branch: nonzero returns pixelCount, zero calls QueryBytesPerPixel and multiplies by pixelCount.
The dependency frontier has one direct callee, zVid_Image::QueryBytesPerPixel at 0x46ec20, already functionally accepted with no visible source blockers.
The native smoke verifies both observed branches on a configured zVidImagePartial: 16-bit non-paletted data returns 256 bytes for 128 pixels, while paletted data returns 128 bytes.
